Search Facilities.description: Searches the facility registry with filters; the adaptor fetches every page for you.

Get Facility By MFR ID.description: Fetches the full details of one facility by its MFR id.

Get Facility By DHIS2 ID.description: Fetches a facility using its DHIS2 organisation unit id.
Get Facility By DHIS2 ID.code:
// Look up a facility from its DHIS2 org unit uid.
get(`Facility/${$.data.orgUnitId}`);

Find Facilities By Name.description: Lists facilities in full detail that match a name and location filters.

Export Facilities As CSV.description: Exports matching facilities as CSV text, e.g. to load into a spreadsheet or data warehouse.

List Regions.description: Lists all regions in the administrative hierarchy.
List Regions.code:
// List regions (top of the location hierarchy).
get('Location/Regions');

List Zones.description: Lists all zones, each linked to its region.
List Zones.code:
// List zones (each carries its regionId).
get('Location/Zones');

List Woredas.description: Lists all woredas (districts), each linked to its zone.
List Woredas.code:
// List woredas (each carries its zoneId).
get('Location/Woredas');

List Lookup Values.description: Lists one reference-data table, such as facility types or ownership.
